releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.2 (Build 13)
• WhatsApp-style instant messaging with immediate optimistic rendering and async sync
• SQLite database v9 schema migration with automatic demo data purging
• WhatsApp-style push-to-talk voice notes with live amplitude waveform visualizer and cancel slider
• Dynamic attachment '+' menu with Gallery Photos, Videos, Camera, Documents, and Location
• Quoted message replies with preview banner and scroll-to-original navigation
• Message long-press actions: Reply, Copy, Forward, Delete for me, and Delete for everyone
• Chat header 3-dot menu: View contact, Search conversation, Mute, Clear chat, and Delete conversation
• Smooth soft keyboard handling with multiline composer and auto-scroll
